business.description: Nandan Denim Limited is among India's largest denim producers with a diverse portfolio spanning fashion denim, shirting and yarn. As a flagship company of the Chiripal Group, it serves leading domestic and international brands, exporters and buying houses through vertically integrated manufacturing facilities equipped with modern technology and advanced machinery.

outlook.statement: Focus on improving product and market mix, expanding presence in domestic and international markets, increasing use of renewable energy and maintaining financial discipline. Will also invest selectively in product development and operational capabilities to stay agile in a rapidly changing market.

Global GDP growth is projected to stabilise at 3.0% in CY 2026 and improved to 3.4% in CY 2027. Global textile market is projected to grow from USD 2,281.51 billion in 2026 to around USD 4,273.09 billion by 2035, achieving a CAGR of 7.24%. India's GDP growth projected at 6.6% for FY 2026-27. India's textile sector aims to scale up exports to approximately ₹9 lakh crore.

Indian denim market valued at USD 1.2 billion in 2025, projected to reach USD 1.9 billion by 2034 (CAGR 4.99% from 2026-2034). Global denim market valued at USD 78.90 billion in 2025, projected to reach USD 151.10 billion by 2035 (CAGR 6.61% from 2026-2035).

Opportunities: Rising demand for denim products, global sourcing shift towards India, growth in technical textiles, sustainability-led demand growth, Industry 4.0 adoption, supply chain traceability requirements. Challenges: Geopolitical and supply chain disruptions, tariff and trade uncertainties, volatility in raw material prices, intensifying global competition.

Enhancement in Jigger Production Capacity has significantly increased the production of value-added finished fabrics like overdyeing etc., resulting in improved customer base. We are constantly working on regular development of product in denim as well in shirting, season based and future expected fashion trend.

NDL aims to become a carbon-neutral Company. Goals include: 1. Use of energy generated from renewable sources of Wind mill and Solar of about 15 million units. 2. To conserve Energy and save 58 KWh/Day by Installed Smart steam turbine with 225KW Generator. 3. Plantation of own greenbelt with over 2,000 trees.
The Group Captive Renewable Energy project is expected to supply additional 14 million units of renewable electricity annually upon commissioning from July 2026.

Nandan Denim has entered into a Group Captive Renewable Energy arrangement to increase the share of renewable electricity in its energy mix. Under this arrangement, the Company will source power from a hybrid renewable energy project comprising 4.3 MW of wind capacity and 4.64 MW (DC) of solar capacity. The project is expected to supply additional 14 million units of renewable electricity annually upon commissioning.

People Risk: Inability to attract and retain skilled employees may affect operational continuity and productivity.
Technological Risk: Inability to integrate or develop new technology can impact market competitiveness.
Environmental Risk: Failure to conform to environmental regulations can adversely affect business operations.
